searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py: 'reward of merit medal'; 'victorian gold brooch seed pearl'; 'opal bar brooch'; 'Melbourne Exhibition 1880 medal'; 'Tasmanian lodge badge' (no hits); work/comps.py: 'brooch gold'. No comps for enamel lodge badges, turquoise ring or hat pin.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'antique 9ct gold seed pearl crescent brooch', 'antique opal bar brooch 9ct', 'victorian repousse gold bar brooch red stones', '9ct gold turquoise cluster ring'. eBay sold: 'Semper Paratus enamel badge', 'Misenis Succurrere badge', 'Reward of Merit gilt star medal enamel', 'Melbourne Exhibition 1880 white metal medal'. Noble Numismatics and Leski realised prices: 'jewellery brooch 9ct' and 'Melbourne exhibition 1880 medal'. Gold content decides the lot: if marks show 9ct/15ct, weigh up scrap plus antique premium.
viewing_check: Check hallmarks/stamps (9, 9ct, 15, 375, 625) on crescent brooch, opal bar brooch, repousse brooch and ring; test whether the opal is solid or a doublet; look at the Reward of Merit medal reverse for inscription/silver mark; read the handwritten jeweller's note; check the Melbourne medals for metal and any named engraving; check Tasmanian badges for maker marks. Weigh the gold pieces if possible.
rate_note: All database prices are AUD already (no conversion). Noble, Leski hammer excl. premium. Gowans/Armitage are paid-locally only, not resale.
